notes: NBIM: NBIM's equity holdings file at June 30, 2026 has no row for The Boeing Company (searched by name: no equity or bond row matches "Boeing"), so nbim is null. CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 common shares by the Q3 2026 10-Q cover count at October 20, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens; the mandatory convertible preferred stock is not in the denominator.
